updates.note: Management reiterated the EBITDA margin range of 19% to 21% for the coming year.
updates.quote: We're still confident that we will operate between 19% to 21%... that's what we'll be targeting for the coming year as well.

updates.note: Management stated they are extending JKY Groove to about 500 EBOs.
updates.quote: for Groove 3, which will be -- which has started hitting the market in the month of May, we are actually extending it to about 500 exclusive brand stores

new_promises.statement: We expect to realize around INR40 crores to INR50 crores of subsidy in FY27.
new_promises.quote: in FY27, we have plans to start realizing the subsidies. So over the year, I think we are expecting we should be getting around INR40 crores to INR50 crores of subsidy
new_promises.speaker: Deepanjan Bandyopadhyay

new_promises.statement: We target to take marketing expenditure up to close to 5% next year.
new_promises.quote: For the bygone year, it's about a little over 4%. We target to take that up to close to 5% in the next year.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra
